bio.text: Jacque Phillips, a Democrat, has represented District 31 in the Colorado House of Representatives since January 2025.
According to Ballotpedia, she ran for re-election and lost in the June 30, 2026 Democratic primary; her current term ends January 12, 2027.
Phillips earned a Ph.D. from the University of Northern Colorado and a law degree from the University of Denver, and has worked as an attorney.
